stages.name: Elementary school (K–5)
stages.blurb: Numbers, reading and writing, science and the world around us, learned with a grown-up close by.

stages.name: Middle school (6–8)
stages.blurb: Ratios to algebra, reading for evidence and argument, and the life, physical and earth sciences.

stages.name: High school (9–12)
stages.blurb: Algebra through calculus, statistics, biology, chemistry, physics, English and history.

stages.name: College pre-medical
stages.blurb: The biology, chemistry, physics, biochemistry, genetics and behavioral science medical schools expect, and the MCAT.

stages.name: Medical school foundations
stages.blurb: Anatomy, embryology, histology, physiology, biochemistry, genetics, immunology, microbiology, pathology, pharmacology, evidence, ethics and clinical skills.

stages.name: Organ systems
stages.blurb: Each body system from normal structure and function to disease, diagnosis and treatment.

stages.name: Clinical clerkships and boards
stages.blurb: The core rotations, then integrated review for USMLE Step 1 and Step 2 CK.
